title: Oshimiri Atata

hinglish.chorus:
Oshimiri Atata
Oshimiri Atata
Oshimiri Atata
River that never runs dry
Nadi jo sookhe na kabhi
hinglish.verse1:
Hum lete hain wo
Nadi jo sookhe na kabhi
Haan, haan

hindi.chorus:
ओशिमिरी अताता
ओशिमिरी अताता
ओशिमिरी अताता
River that never runs dry
नदी जो सूखे ना कभी
hindi.verse1:
हम लेते हैं वो
नदी जो सूखे ना कभी
हाँ, हाँ

seo_description: Oshimiri Atata lyrics in Hindi and Hinglish by Ps. Arul Thomas — ICM Church 2026
